Overview

Kaposvár is a city in Somogy with a population of 61,441. A charming city in southwestern Hungary, known for its beautiful Csiky Gergely Theatre, the Rippl-Rónai Museum, and the nearby Lake Balaton region. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
